title: Solar SPV Ownership Transfer and REC Attribution Dispute
scenario_text:
**Allegro ETRM — Contract #PPA-2019-037**
Counterparty: SunVista Project 4 LLC | Product: Solar PV (45 MW AC) | Term: 20 yr | COD: June 12, 2020 | Pricing: $32.50/MWh with 2% annual escalator | Offtaker: Conduit Energy Operating Co.

**SharePoint — /Renewables/PPAs/SunVista4/ (folder last modified: Nov 2024)**
File: 'Assignment_and_Assumption_Agreement_EXECUTED.pdf' (uploaded Aug 15, 2024)
Summary: SunVista Solar Development assigns all rights and obligations under PPA-2019-037 to CleanPower Holdings LLC. Assignee assumes 'all SPV-level entities associated with the Project.' Effective upon COD anniversary (June 12, 2024). Conduit consent signature: VP of Energy Supply, Marcus Trujillo.

**M-RETS — Generator ID: MN-SOLAR-04471**
Registered Entity: SunVista Project 4 LLC | Status: Active | Vintage: Jan-Dec 2025 RECs issued: 47,231 | Account Holder: SunVista Development Corp (parent) | Retirement status: None retired for compliance year 2025.

**Teams — Renewable Ops Chat (Feb 3, 2026, 9:47 AM)**
@sarah.lindqvist: Has anyone updated M-RETS for the SunVista 4 transfer? RECs are still generating under the old entity.
@marcus.trujillo: I thought CleanPower's counsel was handling that. They sent a transfer request to M-RETS in September.
@sarah.lindqvist: It's February and nothing's changed in the registry. Are those RECs even ours to claim for RPS compliance?
@marcus.trujillo: The PPA says RECs transfer with energy delivery. As long as we're taking the energy, they're ours regardless of registry name.
@sarah.lindqvist: But the filing with PUC references M-RETS retirement records as proof of REC ownership...
[No further messages]

**Outlook — From: j.nakamura@cleanpower-holdings.com (Oct 2, 2024)**
To: sarah.lindqvist@conduitenergy.com
CC: legal@cleanpower-holdings.com
Subject: RE: M-RETS Account Transfer — Project 4

'Hi Sarah — M-RETS requires the current account holder (SunVista Development Corp) to initiate the transfer. We've been trying to reach their asset management team but SunVista wound down ops in July. Working on getting authorized signatories. Will update.'

**SAP — Vendor Master**
Vendor #400219: SunVista Project 4 LLC (Status: Active, payment block)
Vendor #400387: CleanPower Holdings LLC (Status: Active)
Note on #400219 (entered Dec 2024): 'Do not use — entity transferred. Route all invoices to #400387 per PPA assignment.'
question: For Conduit's 2025 RPS compliance filing with the PUC, can the 47,231 RECs generated by the project be claimed, and under what entity should they be retired?

contributor.name: Sarah Lindqvist
contributor.title: Renewable Energy PPA Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Power purchase agreements, SPV entity tracking, REC management, regulatory compliance filings

choices: Yes — retire under CleanPower Holdings LLC since the Assignment and Assumption Agreement transferred all SPV-level obligations effective June 2024
Yes — retire under SunVista Project 4 LLC since that's the registered entity in M-RETS and the RECs are already properly attributed
Yes — the PPA contractually assigns RECs to Conduit upon energy delivery regardless of registry status, but the M-RETS transfer must be completed before retirement can occur for PUC filing purposes
No — RECs cannot be claimed until the M-RETS account transfer is completed and CleanPower Holdings is the registered entity; filing must exclude these RECs
